thesis:
备件照片拍得清楚，为什么还要核对机型？答案附了页码，为什么还要打开原页？本期四组资料追问的是同一件事：从系统找到的线索，到人愿意签字的结论，中间还差哪一次核对。差的那一步，往往不在模型的计时或评分里。

一张零件照片要回到设备目录，一段引文要回到对应版本的原页，一处图纸冲突要能标出两张图的位置，一条退款回复要能关联到当时的订单与流程版本。共同要求不是保存所有数据，而是让下一位有权限的人能用最少的记录复核具体判断。建议从一次真实争议倒推必需字段，再用错配、缺页和空订单检验记录是否够用。
takeaways: K-Hub 自报的不到五秒是库存查询耗时，不是找到无标签备件所需的时间，更不是设备停机时间。维修试点要追踪领错、退件和未匹配的照片。
Google 示例说明检索可以定位到页或视频时段。要证明引用有用，应让复核人打开原处核对年份和口径，并把导入等待与单次查询延迟分开报告。
MKA 的裁判一致率衡量判分方式，不衡量工程缺陷检出率。若交付物写得完整却标错图号，仍应按原图判错，不能靠版式得分抵消。
n8n 的空订单示例可以返回 HTTP 200。可执行的验收条件是缺金额或币种时停止生成承诺，保存转人工原因，而不是看请求有无报错。
contrarian: “能给出处，就可以少做复核”只在出处确实支持结论时成立。检索示例中，没有员工人数的资产负债表也能被准确定位；MKA 的裁判可以给最终文件打分，却没有替工程师检查现场原图。我们的判断是：高代价决策中，返回出处首先让错误更容易查，而不是让审批可被省略。若在含过期版本、相似零件和冲突图纸的盲测中，减少复核仍不增加严重漏错，并降低每个正确交付物的总成本，这个判断才应调整。

items.title: 仓库备件没有标签：拍照找到料号，不等于设备已经修好
items.type: 企业内部部署／仓储设备维修
items.source: 2026-11-24，亚马逊欧洲发布 K-Hub AI 现场案例；11 月 26 日 SaaSIQ 作行业解读，未独立计时。

relatedLinks.label: 11 月 26 日供应链行业解读

items.summary: 仓库里换下一个没有标签的零件，维修员面临的第一个问题不是怎么买，而是设备厂家和仓库系统各用哪个编号。亚马逊的维修助手允许员工拍下磨损件，同时查内部料号、原厂编号、文字描述和附近库存。以往翻目录可能花半小时仍认不出来，还得等熟悉设备的同事到岗。现在可以先拿候选料号去对照手册和实物。对夜班主管，这个改变的意义在于减少等专家认件的时间；助手展示最近有库存的位置，并不表示货架上一定有货，更不是授权员工直接换件。
items.design: 输入可以是部件照片，也可以是技术员描述的故障症状。系统把照片与备件目录对应，将设备、历史维修记录、厂家手册和库存信息联系起来；答复指回具体的正式文件，经批准的来源中没有信息时应明确告知。员工把建议与现场观察相互核对，企业安全规定和本地人员判断优先。亚马逊提到知识图谱和代理路由，但没有公开各站点的账户权限、视觉匹配阈值、查库存超时怎样处理，或工具是否有领料写入权。若本地试用，无法核实机型或尺寸时只显示待核对，不生成领料单。
items.evidence: 证据等级：具名运营方的一手部署自报，行业报道为转述，没有独立效果测量。公司称助手已在全球数百个站点使用，拍照查件功能于八月推出。文中列出两个不同的时钟：查询单个部件在网络内的可用库存，原来约十分钟，现在不到五秒；识别无标签零件，过去可能翻目录超过三十分钟仍无结果，现在称不到两分钟。前者不是到货时间，后者也不是设备恢复时间。公司没有给出计时样本数、按机型划分的识别正确率、错领退件或停机时间对照。编辑判断：如果只对成功匹配的照片计时，最快的查询会掩盖最难的故障；验收应把未识别、错配与等人确认都算进去。
items.idea: 给仓库备件管理员做只读识别台，先收一种设备的无标签件照片，返回候选料号和对应手册页，不接采购系统。由两位维修员对照实物和规格裁定正确答案；将找不到也记为一次查询，比较人工查号与拍照辅助的正确识别耗时、错配数和转交专家比例。

items.title: 员工人数在哪一页？先让检索交出可复查的位置
items.type: 工程演示与公开代码｜带页码和时间戳的检索
items.source: 2026-11-24，Google 开发者博客；配套资料为 Google Cloud 接口文档与两份公开示例。
items.summary: 查一家公司的员工总数，财报里的资产负债表和员工统计表都可能因为出现同一家公司而被搜到。谷歌在公开预览中展示了一种检索接口：它交回文件地址和原文页码；如果材料是演讲录像，就返回可跳转的起止时间。对编写简报的人，这比拿到一段流畅的回答更容易验收：点开后能看清数字属于哪年，是全公司还是某个部门。演示还显示，同一个问题开启重排后，不相关的财务报表页可以从前几条结果中移走。不过，定位到相关页只是查证的起点，不能视为系统已经解释了数字的口径。
items.design: 文档与视频分别建库，服务账号被授权读取云存储里的文件。文档按页或文本块切分后生成向量；查询结合语义与全文匹配，可按年份、文件或页码筛选，再选择是否重排。视频按固定时间窗切分，默认只看画面，开启音频后才把第一条音轨与画面一并编码；视频检索不支持文档的重排开关。调用方得到候选片段而不是经过审批的答案。文章没有证明读取源文件的服务账号会替每名提问者校验权限，也没有交代超时恢复。用于内部资料时，建议应用先限定可查文件，找不到支持原句的片段就停在待核状态。
items.evidence: 证据等级：厂商演示并提供可复跑代码，未见独立实测。作者报告十八份公开投资者文件约九分钟可查；问员工人数时，未重排的前五条中有两页资产负债表并未谈到员工，开启重排后排在前面的结果均包含人数。这是一个问题的对照，不是整库的准确率。五段示例视频总长约十九分钟，单次查询耗时零点三至零点五秒；把它们导入两个库耗时二十至四十五分钟，不能把查询延迟当作新材料上线速度。公开样本没有涵盖撤权文件、相互矛盾的修订版或高并发负载。编辑判断：样例能说明引文可以回到原处，不能据此宣称企业核稿更快，仍需用实际问题测量找错版本和人工纠错的代价。
items.idea: 给内部培训编辑做一个只读索引，只收一门课程已批准的手册和录屏。由讲师先标出一组问题的正确页码或时间段，编辑盲测后打开原件并勾选是否足以支持结论；另放入旧版同名材料测误选。分别记录前五条命中率、错版率和每题核对分钟数，不让工具直接修改培训内容。

items.title: 建筑图纸会审：交出一套幻灯片，不等于找全了图间冲突
items.type: 多模态专业任务基准／公开样题与榜单快照
items.source: 2026-11-10，Google DeepMind 公布 MKA；11 月 18 日提交论文；11 月 23 日 BenchLM 汇集榜单数据，并非新增复测。

relatedLinks.label: 基准发布与专家校验说明

items.summary: 建筑项目开会前，审图人员要比对同一处开口在平面、立面和剖面图上的画法，再把可疑之处标给同事。MKA 的公开示例就把这种工作做成一道交付题：输入十二个文件，其中包括一份会审标准和多张图纸，输出不是一句是否合规，而是一份可打开的审查演示稿。只抽取图上的文字，容易保住门窗编号，却丢掉它和楼层、位置的关系。企业试用多模态助手时，可以借这道题追问：报告写得整齐之外，复核人能不能顺着它回到两张相互矛盾的图，判断是否真要提请澄清？
items.design: 评测执行方给每个代理一个装有输入文件的隔离工作区，可运行代码、检索网页，并向支持图像输入的模型展示图片；工具交互最多二百五十轮。代理生成演示稿或其他文件后，另一模型在单独环境中查看交付物和最终回复，依专家预写的逐项要求评分。这个裁判看不到原始输入；没有交文件也没有最终回复时得零分。这里的联网权限是基准设置，不是建设单位允许上传图纸。落地宜限于已授权项目的只读副本，图号不清或两版无法对应就停止下结论，由审图人对照原图后再发问题单。
items.evidence: 证据等级：有公开方法与样题的受控评测，不是客户现场验收。正式测试集含二百项任务，覆盖十个行业领域、八十三种职业；另有十项公开任务，不能用它们重跑整份榜单。发布方称专家与自动裁判的判定有百分之九十六一致，这不是模型找出百分之九十六的图纸缺陷。执行方把较难要求按权重计算满足比例，再跨题平均；它与整份交付物一次通过率不是同一指标。十一月二十三日的第三方榜单只是汇集已有结果，未重新跑题。编辑判断：裁判可查幻灯片是否列出预期内容，却不能代替工程师对原图签字；现有数字也不足以估算实际审图时间、遗漏严重冲突的概率或返工成本。
items.idea: 给设计协调员做一个会前对图清单，只取同一项目已授权的一组立面和剖面，不自动发出整改要求。每条疑点必须带两张图的图号、页码及局部截图，缺一侧就标待核。用历史已澄清问题做盲审，统计严重漏项、误报、能回到两处原图的比例和逐项复核分钟数。

items.title: 退款回复显示成功，财务还能查到当时读的是哪笔订单吗？
items.type: 工程教程与托管平台文档｜代理审计
items.source: 2026-11-24，n8n 发布五个工作流练习；对照不列颠哥伦比亚省政府 Common Hosted Workflow 平台文档。

relatedLinks.label: 托管平台：审计事件与执行轨迹的归因缺口

items.summary: 退款客服说会处理一笔重复扣款，财务事后却发现，当时的订单查询根本没返回金额。今天重新查订单并不能解释昨天的回复，因为订单和提示词都可能已经改过。n8n 的新教程把这道题拆开：先找到当次工作流拿到的订单快照，再核对当时运行的版本和模型给出的答复；跨服务追踪则用来定位哪一步调用了查询工具。练习故意让无有效订单的请求也能得到成功响应，以便客服主管看见差别：系统确实答过，不代表答复有依据，更不代表已经向客户退钱。
items.design: 入口接收订单编号和客户消息，查询节点返回当时的订单资料。加入校验后，找不到订单或缺少金额、币种的请求分流到人工复核，完整记录才交给模型拟答。模型不接支付工具。执行记录保存节点输入输出，工作流版本和执行编号用来定位当次配置；追踪主要记录调用关系、耗时和状态，不能替代订单快照。实例所有者或管理员配置追踪，外部收集端另有访问与留存规则。资料未给出财务人员的逐单阅览权限或人工队列超时办法；试点应把超时件留在待办中，不自动承诺退款。
items.evidence: 证据等级：厂商可操作教程，加独立托管平台文档作机制对照。首个练习安排三种模拟输入：一笔四十九点九九美元的完整订单、一笔不存在的订单、以及金额和币种为空的订单。未加校验时，三者预期都可返回成功状态；加校验后，后两种应转人工。三例是预设测试，不是真实退款样本，教程没有报告误承诺率、实际到账或审计工时。独立平台文档指出，追踪抽样可漏掉整次执行，且记录通常不含经认证的用户身份；这印证轨迹不宜单独作审计依据，并非对该练习效果的复测。编辑判断：保住原始查询和版本号比只保留成功率更能回答争议，但多留数据是否值得，要同时核算存储成本和隐私风险。
items.idea: 让财务质检员从脱敏客服记录里抽一批有争议的回复，只做只读对账，不连退款接口。分别给复核人当前订单和当时的查询快照，盲审能否判断原答复有无依据。统计可还原比例、误判为已退款的次数、每件核对分钟数；无法定位原记录的单列为证据不足。

projectIdeas.title: 备件照片与领用结果对账
projectIdeas.description: 给一个仓库的维修领班搭建只读试点，只覆盖一种设备。库管员核对候选料号、机型与最终领用记录；保留拒配和退件。比较人工查询与辅助查询的总用时、首次领对率和错误领用数，不触发采购。

projectIdeas.title: 引用支持度盲审台
projectIdeas.description: 供运营知识库编辑使用，只选同一制度的新旧两个版本。检索返回页码和原段，两名复核人独立判断其能否支持答案，冲突回到文档负责人。按问题统计引用错版率、无依据却放行的比例和核验分钟数。

en.thesis:
Why check the equipment model when the part photo is clear? Why open the original page when an answer cites a page number? Four sources expose the gap between a clue the system can find and a conclusion someone can sign off on. The missing check often sits outside the model’s timer or score.

A part photo needs the equipment catalog; a citation needs the original page in the right version; a drawing conflict needs locations on both sheets; a refund reply needs the order and workflow version used at the time. Do not retain everything. Retain the minimum records another authorized person needs to review a specific decision. Work backward from a real dispute, then test whether the records suffice for a mismatch, a missing page or an empty order.
takeaways: K-Hub’s reported sub-five-second time measures inventory lookup, not unlabeled part identification or downtime. Track incorrect issues, returns and unmatched photos.
Google’s demo locates pages and video intervals. Have reviewers verify the year and definition at the source, and report ingestion time separately from query latency.
MKA’s judge agreement measures the scoring method, not detection of engineering defects. A complete-looking deliverable with the wrong drawing reference should still fail that check.
n8n’s missing-order example can return HTTP 200. Require the workflow to stop before making a promise when amount or currency is absent, and record why it escalated.
en.contrarian: A citation justifies less review only if it supports the conclusion. The retrieval demo can locate a balance sheet that says nothing about headcount. An MKA judge scores a final file but does not inspect original drawings on an engineer’s behalf. We think source links primarily make high-stakes mistakes easier to investigate; they do not remove the need for approval. Revise that view if blinded tests with stale versions, similar parts and conflicting drawings show that less review does not increase serious misses and reduces total cost per correct deliverable.

items.title: An unlabeled warehouse part: finding a part number is not fixing the equipment
items.source: 2026-11-24, Amazon Europe published its K-Hub AI field account; SaaSIQ’s November 26 industry commentary did not independently time the work.
items.summary: When an unlabeled part comes off a warehouse machine, the first question is not how to buy it but which identifiers the manufacturer and the warehouse use. Amazon’s maintenance assistant lets staff photograph a worn part and look up internal numbers, OEM references, descriptions and nearby inventory together. Previously, half an hour in catalogs might still leave the technician waiting for a colleague familiar with the equipment. A candidate identifier can now be checked against the manual and the physical part. For a night-shift supervisor the opportunity is less waiting for an expert. A nearby stock location is neither proof the item is on the shelf nor authorization to replace it.
items.design: Inputs include component photographs and technician descriptions of symptoms. The system matches photographs to the parts catalog and connects equipment, repair history, manufacturer manuals and inventory. Answers point back to specific official documents; the assistant should say when approved sources lack the information. Technicians compare suggestions with observations on site; company safety rules and local judgment take precedence. Amazon mentions a knowledge graph and agentic routing but does not publish site account permissions, visual match thresholds, stock-query timeout handling or authority to issue parts. A local pilot should mark unresolved model or dimension checks as pending and not generate an issue order.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: first-hand deployment account from the named operator, with secondary coverage but no independent outcome measurement. Amazon reports use at hundreds of sites globally and an August launch for visual search. It describes two distinct clocks: checking network stock for one part fell from roughly ten minutes to under five seconds; identifying an unlabeled part once could involve over thirty minutes of unsuccessful catalog searching and is now said to take under two minutes. The first is not arrival time; the second is not time to restore equipment. The account gives no timing sample size, identification accuracy by equipment model, comparison of wrong issues and returns, or downtime comparison. Our judgment: timing only successful photos hides the hardest cases. Include no-matches, mismatches and waiting for confirmation.
items.idea: Give parts coordinators a read-only identification station for photos from one equipment family. Return candidate numbers and manual pages without connecting procurement. Two technicians establish ground truth against physical parts and specifications. Count unsuccessful searches as attempts; compare time to correct identification, mismatches and expert referrals against manual lookups.

items.title: Which page gives the headcount? Make search return a location a reviewer can check
items.type: Engineering demonstration and public code | Retrieval with page and time references
items.source: 2026-11-24, Google Developers Blog, with Google Cloud API documentation and two public examples.
items.summary: When looking for a company's headcount, both a balance sheet and a workforce table may surface because both mention the company. In public preview, Google demonstrated a search interface that returns the source file and page, or start and end times for recorded talks. For a briefing editor, that is easier to verify than a fluent answer alone: opening the source reveals the year and whether the number covers the whole company or one division. In the example, reranking the same query removed irrelevant financial pages from the top results. Finding a relevant page starts verification; it doesn't establish that the system interpreted the number correctly.
items.design: Documents and videos go into separate stores; a service account receives permission to read cloud storage files. Documents are segmented by page or chunk and embedded. Queries combine semantic and full-text matching, optional year, file or page constraints, and optional reranking. Videos use fixed windows. By default only frames are embedded; audio mode encodes the first audio track with the frames. Video search does not support the document reranking option. The caller receives candidate passages, not an approved answer. The article does not establish that the ingestion service account enforces each questioner's file permissions or explain timeout recovery. For internal use, restrict searchable files first and leave unsupported claims pending review.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: vendor demonstration with runnable code, no independent replication identified. The authors report that 18 public investor PDFs became searchable in about nine minutes. For one headcount question, two of the top five results before reranking were balance sheets that did not discuss employees; the top results after reranking all stated the headcount. That is a single-query comparison, not corpus accuracy. Five sample videos totaled about 19 minutes; queries took 0.3–0.5 seconds, while importing them into two stores took 20–45 minutes. Query latency does not measure how quickly new material goes live. The examples do not test revoked access, conflicting revisions or high concurrency. Our judgment: they demonstrate traceable locations, not faster enterprise review. Measure wrong-version selections and correction costs on real questions.
items.idea: Build a read-only index for training editors using only approved manuals and recordings from one course. Have an instructor label correct pages or time intervals for a question set. Editors test blind, open originals and mark whether the source supports the conclusion. Include an older identically named version to test misselection. Track top-five hits, wrong-version rate and review minutes per question. Do not edit course content automatically.

items.title: Drawing coordination: a finished deck does not mean every conflict was found
items.type: Multimodal professional-task benchmark / public example and leaderboard snapshot
items.source: Google DeepMind announced MKA on 2026-11-10; the paper was submitted November 18. BenchLM compiled leaderboard data on November 23, not a new independent run.
items.summary: Before a construction coordination meeting, reviewers may need to compare the same opening across plan, elevation and section drawings and flag discrepancies for colleagues. A public MKA example turns this into a deliverable: twelve input files, including a review standard and several drawings, lead to a slide deck that others can open, not a one-line compliance verdict. Text extraction may preserve a door or window identifier while losing its relationship to position or floor. When piloting a multimodal assistant, ask whether a reviewer can trace each apparent conflict back to both drawings and decide whether clarification is warranted, regardless of how polished the deck looks.
items.design: The evaluator provides an isolated workspace containing input files. Agents can run code, search the web and show images to models that accept them; interactions are limited to 250 turns. After the agent produces a deck or another file, a separate model inspects the submitted artifacts and final reply in its own environment and grades expert-written criteria. That judge does not see the original inputs. A run with neither a file nor a final reply scores zero. Internet access is a benchmark setting, not permission to upload a client's drawings. A pilot should use read-only copies from authorized projects and stop short of a conclusion when drawing IDs or revisions cannot be matched. A reviewer should check the originals before issuing a query.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: controlled evaluation with published methodology and examples, not customer acceptance testing. Its private evaluation has 200 tasks across ten sectors and 83 occupations; the ten separately released tasks cannot reproduce the complete leaderboard. The developers report 96% agreement between expert and automated judgments, not 96% detection of drawing defects by the evaluated agents. The evaluator weights the harder criteria satisfied on each task and averages across tasks; this is not a first-pass acceptance rate for entire deliverables. The third-party November 23 leaderboard is a compilation, not a rerun. Our judgment: a grader can check for expected content in the slides but cannot replace an engineer signing off on the drawings. These numbers do not establish review time, the probability of missing a serious conflict or rework cost.
items.idea: Build a pre-meeting checklist for design coordinators using one authorized pair of elevation and section drawings from a single project. Do not issue change instructions automatically. Each concern needs IDs, page numbers and crops from both drawings; otherwise flag it for review. Blind-test against resolved historical queries and measure serious omissions, false alarms, the share traceable to both drawings and review minutes per item.

items.title: A refund reply succeeded—but can Finance find the order the agent actually saw?
items.type: Engineering tutorial and hosting-platform documentation | Agent audit
items.source: 2026-11-24, n8n published five workflow exercises; compared with the British Columbia government’s Common Hosted Workflow documentation.

relatedLinks.label: Hosting-platform guide: attribution gaps in audit events and execution traces

items.summary: A support agent promises to handle a duplicate charge, but Finance later discovers that the lookup contained no amount. Querying the order today cannot explain yesterday’s reply: the order and the prompt may both have changed. n8n’s tutorial starts with the snapshot returned to that particular run, then checks the workflow version and the model’s reply. Cross-service tracing helps locate the tool call. The exercise deliberately allows a successful response even without a usable order. A reply proves that the system answered, not that it had grounds for the answer or that any money reached the customer.
items.design: The entry point accepts an order ID and customer message; a lookup returns the order data available at the time. With validation enabled, absent orders or missing amounts and currencies route to human review; only complete records reach the model for drafting. The model is not connected to payments. Execution records capture node inputs and outputs; workflow version and execution ID help identify the configuration. Traces mainly describe calls, duration and status, not order snapshots. Instance owners or administrators configure tracing; the collector has its own access and retention rules. The sources do not specify per-case access for finance or review-queue timeouts. A pilot should keep overdue cases pending rather than promise a refund.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: an executable vendor tutorial, with independent hosting documentation corroborating mechanisms. Exercise one supplies three simulated inputs: a complete $49.99 order, a nonexistent order and an order missing both amount and currency. All three are expected to return success before validation; the latter two should route to review afterwards. These are designed tests, not a real refund sample. The tutorial reports neither rates of unsupported promises nor actual payments or audit labor. Independent platform documentation notes that sampling can omit entire traces and that spans generally lack an authenticated-user identity. This supports the limits of traces as audit evidence; it does not replicate the exercise. Our judgment: keeping original lookups and version IDs helps explain disputes better than a success rate alone, but extra retention must justify its storage cost and privacy exposure.
items.idea: Give finance quality reviewers a de-identified sample of disputed replies. Use read-only reconciliation with no payment connection. Blind reviewers to the reference decision and compare their judgments using current orders versus contemporaneous lookup snapshots. Measure reconstructability, false conclusions that refunds were paid and minutes per review. Mark cases with unlocatable original records as insufficient evidence.

projectIdeas.title: Reconcile part photos with parts issued
projectIdeas.description: Build a read-only pilot for one warehouse maintenance lead and one equipment type. A stockroom operator checks candidate part numbers, equipment model and the eventual issue record; retain rejected matches and returns. Compare total time, first-time correct issues and incorrect issues with manual lookup. No purchasing.

projectIdeas.title: Blind-review desk for citation support
projectIdeas.description: For operations knowledge editors, use just two versions of one policy. Return the page and passage; two reviewers independently assess support for the answer. Refer disagreements to the document owner. Track wrong-version citations, unsupported approvals and review minutes per question.
